label: RE-SEARCH 1: Petrova 1.0.0 on the 803 binary stars (5 days or longer) of the G2 and G3 lists that were not looked at while the filter was designed (blind, counts only)

stopped_by.text: Near a data gap or a spacecraft momentum dump
The upside-down copy has the same wiggle
Sits at a catalogue eclipse phase
Many similar dips in the same light curve
The baseline jumps across the dip
Sits on a slow ramp after data resumes
A stronger event of the other kind in the same curve

notes.text: G3 finished at 01:24 on 4 Nov and is scored: no excess of real dips over noise (cleaned-light half, bar 7: 18 real, 31 upside-down, 23.5 expected from noise). The false-alarm line still misses its mark (9.34 per 1,000 against 8), as in G2. Counts only; the scorecard is in the 4 Nov field note.
